meta.title: Quentin Poullain · Software developer, C#, JavaScript, SQL
meta.description: Quentin Poullain, a Paris-based software developer working in C#, JavaScript and SQL. Business applications end to end, from specs to production and user support.

hero.badge: Based in Paris, open to relocation
hero.title: Business software you can <hl>rely on</hl>, from spec to production.
hero.intro: I'm Quentin Poullain, a software developer working in C#, JavaScript and SQL. I turn functional specs into technical designs, then build, test and document the software, and support the people who use it every day.

projects.title: Projects I took from start to finish.
projects.intro: Two public repositories worth a closer look, followed by the tools I host and use myself.

admissionsHub.tagline: Applications from several schools, synced with Salesforce
admissionsHub.description: Roles and per-school isolation enforced by the API, each application pushed to Salesforce as a Lead over OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, Zod schemas shared by front end and API, OpenAPI 3.1 docs, bilingual interface.
admissionsHub.coverAlt: Admissions Hub application list: counters by status, school filter and Salesforce sync state.

pokefeet.tagline: Guess the Pokémon from its footprint
pokefeet.description: One puzzle a day, an endless mode, and hints that unlock as you keep guessing.

cleanup.description: A small tool that deletes, after confirmation, the Claude Code Remote Control environments that stay listed once they have stopped.

hub.description: Homelab dashboard: passkey sign-in (WebAuthn), Docker agent, tests.

request.description: Media request app wired into Sonarr and Radarr.

viewer.description: Native Emby client for Windows and Android TV.

expertise.title: Where I'm most useful.
expertise.ai: I work with AI coding agents (Claude Code) every day to ship faster.

business.title: Business applications
business.text: Design and development in C#, .NET and Blazor: the user interface of the Infodrone, DroneBlocker and DroneDetector counter-drone range, a monitoring system for a whole IT estate, a USB burning app for medical imaging.

web.title: Full-stack web
web.text: Interfaces and APIs in JavaScript and TypeScript, backed by SQL databases.

lifecycle.title: The whole cycle
lifecycle.text: From the need to the technical design, then testing, acceptance, production release and user support, documentation included.

trustcomsRd.text: Core of the job: the user interface of the Infodrone, DroneBlocker and DroneDetector counter-drone range (one shared interface, extra features depending on the product) and its features, front end and back end (forwarder, REST export…). New features (automatic replay, detection modes) from technical design to production. Alongside, designing and building a monitoring system for an IT estate spread across France. Support, test plans and documentation.

trustcomsAlt.text: New features (flight replay, map markers), test setup, technical and user documentation.

mptronic.text: A business app that burns patient exams onto USB drives, bug fixes on the radiology application, user documentation.
